senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) [the flame-colored, cmp. אַרְיֵה,] lion.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:2">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> the lion has six names <he>ארי כפיר ל׳ וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:5">Ib. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>מי … בין ל׳ ללְבִיאָה</he> who will dare to throw his garment between the lion and the lioness?—Pl. <cite ref="L00037"><he>לְבָאִים</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:46">Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 57:5">Ps. LVII, 5</cite>) <he>זה … שהיו ל׳ בתורה</he> this refers to Abner and Amasah who were lions in the Law (v. <cite ref="A03086"><he>אַרְיֵה</he></cite>); Pesik. Par., p. 31ᵇ; a. e.
